titulo: Games Will Have A Physical Footprint Forever, Take-Two Boss Says, But It’ll Be “Very Small”
texto: It's no secret that the market for physical video games is drying up, but don't expect physical media for gaming to go away entirely anytime soon, or ever, according to Take-Two's Strauss Zelnick. He told The Game Business that it "may not be the end" for physical media entirely in games, even with Sony killing off PlayStation discs in 2028 . He said there will "always be some physical business" for gaming, but it will be a "very small part of the business." Lucia and Jason in GTA 6. He likened the scale of it to the vinyl business for recorded music. Most people might stream music today, but the market for vinyl is still there--and it's growing. For Take-Two, however, Zelnick said its business today is 98% digital. Going all-digital has a lot of benefits for publishers, but it's mainly about making more money.
